reviews.title: Awesome running app!
reviews.text: I have not been able to run in months and I got the ok to run a couple months ago as I have been really sick. I started running on my own at first. I then heard about Endorphins App. I got the app and it has been a game changer to my running. It’s an amazing app and has been helping me so much for my first race and giving me so much support!

reviews.title: Easy to use and great for marathon training
reviews.text: I’m using endorphins to plan my half marathon training and the UI has been super easy to follow. The live coaching has been extremely useful in guiding my training as a beginner!

reviews.title: Got me back to consistent training
reviews.text: After a long break from running, I needed a way to rebuild the habit. Endorphins has helped me stay on track week to week, and having a structured plan takes the guesswork out of getting back into it. I'm building toward a few upcoming 5Ks with the goal of setting a new PR, and I finally feel like I have a real path to being race day ready. Highly recommend it if you're starting over or coming back after time away.

reviews.title: It’s Okay
reviews.text: It’s okay. AI is a clunky and makes recommendations that don’t jive with my actual training. Training plans are easy to adjust but definitely don’t push me as other apps have. I cannot get it to take the injury off the plan so I am supplementing runs with Runna. Biggest issue now is it is NOT easy to cancel and I cannot get anyone to message me back about cancelling but they were very fast to message back to sign me up. For that reason, I will for sure be cancelling because it should not be this difficult. It doesn’t go through the App Store and doesn’t even show as a subscription.

reviews.title: BEST RUNNING APP EVER!!! ⭐️🏃🏻‍♀️🔥
reviews.text:
I’m training for my first half marathon and Endorphins has made it SO easy and enjoyable. This app does everything for you — plan workouts, tracks your
recovery, and predicts your race results. I feel myself getting stronger everyday while using this app. It even has coaches you can message on the app, so you can ask anything about your training plan or runs and it’ll give you a thorough answer. Love love love this app 🙌🏼

reviews.title: Great tool - motivated 100%
reviews.text:
I’m really loving the Endorphins Running app! 🏃‍♀️❤️ It’s such a great way to connect with other runners, stay motivated, and feel part of a running community. Everyone has been so welcoming and encouraging, and I love being able to discover runs and meet people who share the same passion.

If you’re a runner looking for motivation, community, and a little extra accountability, I definitely recommend giving Endorphins a try! 🙌🏃‍♀️

reviews.title: Best Running app out there
reviews.text: I have loved using this running app! It goes very in depth with everything you need to know to hit your goals. I like how it adjust my pace times based on my last run. Would highly recommend to anyone!

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: I love endorphins and all the feed back you get during your training as well as the option to ask questions tailored to you. It’s great for all experience levels and easy to use. I recommend it to everyone

reviews.title: Will never train without it!
reviews.text: Endorphins is truly an incredible app and such a huge help if you’re training for a race. It takes the brainwork out of it and lets you just have a very straightforward and detailed plan to follow that is customized to you, your paces and your goals. The coach input on each run is so helpful as well. I love how you can toggle between outdoor and treadmill as well depending on where you’re able to run each day! I’m sure there’s so many other features that I haven’t even discovered yet but can’t wait to keep using it! Lifesaver!

reviews.title: Great First Impression
reviews.text:
So far, I’m really liking the Endorphins app! I’ve only just started using it, but I’ve found it really easy to follow and navigate. I like being able to see my planned workouts, check them off as I complete them, and get feedback along the way.

I also really like the coaching aspect of the premium subscription. The notes, notifications, positive feedback, and suggestions for things I can improve make it feel more personalized than just following a training plan on my own.

My only concern so far is the Apple Watch integration. My Apple Health is connected to the app, but I wasn’t able to start my planned workout directly from my Apple Watch through the Endorphins app. Because of that, today’s speed/interval workout didn’t register properly. I’m not sure if that was user error or a limitation with the app, so I’m going to try it again with my next interval workout before I make a final judgment on that.

Overall, though, my first impression is really positive. It’s simple, motivating, and easy to follow, and I’m excited to see how I like it as I continue through my training plan!

reviews.title: Genuinely great
reviews.text: I was not expecting to love this app so much. I thought I would be fine with a free online marathon plan, but had a free trial so I thought why not? I love that it synchs to my Garmin and that the pace adjusts automatically. I also love that it breaks down everything to my specifications. I feel like the price is very reasonable for what you do get, which has forever changed my training

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text: I am now using their training program to help me run my 2nd marathon! I love how easy it is to set up my training plan exactly how I want it and get me a PR come my marathon in Feb!

reviews.title: Useful cool running app
reviews.text: Really nice app with a lot of useful features. My favorite part is how it keeps all the Endorphins groups across the US connected and keeps you updated on what’s going on. It makes it feel like you’re part of a much bigger running community instead of just your local group. Really cool app for runners!

reviews.title: Run plans
reviews.text: The coaching guidance is top tier! 1st week and I PRd and on the way to hitting my goal time, pace and mileage!

reviews.title: Highly effective
reviews.text: As someone who is not a runner, endorphins gives me all the tools and confidence I need to start my running journey to a half marathon. A structured weekly training plan keeps me motivated and ready for what’s to come. The live coach adapts to my workouts and recovery to give advice and even connects to my Garmin for live data. I feel confident going into my half marathon having used the endorphins training plan!

reviews.title: More than just a running app ⭐️
reviews.text: Endorphins has made running feel like more than just training for me. I love having a space that keeps me motivated, helps me stay consistent, and makes running feel like a community rather than something I have to do alone. As someone who’s balanced running with school, work, and everyday life, having that extra structure and motivation has made such a difference. It’s helped me continue setting goals for myself while actually enjoying the process. I’m excited to keep growing as a runner with Endorphins!

reviews.title: Best Training App Format
reviews.text: I just recently signed up for Endorphins and it is by far one of the most intuitive training apps for running I’ve found. The ability to customize and get hyper specific for each workout is exactly what I was looking for, I haven’t seen any other app getting as personalized as this one!

reviews.title: Great for groups & data
reviews.text: So far I’ve really enjoyed the social and groups features of this app - it’s especially helpful if you live in a big city and you’re looking to find other people to run with in your area. I haven’t used the plan building features yet, but I find the data summaries related to my sleep and workouts useful and I like how easily compatible it is with Garmin data.

reviews.title: Loving this App!
reviews.text: Endorphins has been such a great addition to my training! I love that it connects with Garmin and gives personalized coaching suggestions based on things like my recovery, training, and even the weather. I love being able to see how all of those factors can affect my runs. It’s made my training feel more intentional while still keeping it fun and motivating!

reviews.title: Better than I EXPECTED!
reviews.text: I was really happy and surprised to see how clean, and functional the app is! With events going in nearby and how easy tracking my run, It could be my go to running app!

reviews.title: Great running app!
reviews.text: I’m obsessed with Endorphins running. I started running to improve my cardio (I used to get winded at a 5-10 min bike ride), but I’ve been using it to help me do cardio for longer amounts of time, and now I can ride my bike 3-4 miles without feeling like I’m gonna die! Thank uu so much team🙏🏾🙏🏾

reviews.title: Great app all around
reviews.text: So far so great, I have been using the trial and about to start the real thing. I like the integration with all my other apps, it feels super smooth and intuitive, helps adjust based off sleep and weather, all around great app

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: So far so great, I have been using the trial and about to start the real thing. I like the integration with all my other apps, it feels super smooth and intuitive, helps adjust based off sleep and weather, all around great app

reviews.title: Your running buddy
reviews.text: At first I was skeptical about this kind of apps but when I try it I was a really good help, not only as a reminder of my activities but as a motivation when I’m not in my best energy day to train.

reviews.title: Ben Pensy Endorphins Review
reviews.text: The Endorphins Running app has really helped me visualize and structure my training. The app helps me push when my body is recovered, and pull back when I am not. It structures my training so I can make maximum running gains and reach my running goals!

reviews.title: Love this app!!!
reviews.text:
The Endorphins Running app is amazing. It’s completely taken the guesswork out of my marathon training — I no longer have to sit there figuring out what runs to do each week to feel prepared. It just tells me, and I show up and do the work.

The groups tab is the real standout though. I found the Endorphins NYC Run Club, joined for the first time this past Saturday, and ran 10 miles with them. I loved it. Great workout, real sense of community, and I actually made friends. Long runs can be brutal to do alone, and this turned mine into something I look forward to.

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text: This app has given me an incredible structure for training for my first marathon. The ai coaches help you every step of the way. I couldn’t imagine using another app!!

reviews.title: Awesome app
reviews.text: Been using it to join their running group in NYC. Really easy to use and a great platform overall

reviews.title: Weird
reviews.text: I'm surprised it doesn't mention how this is all AI. There is no coach, the interface shows a person as a coach but the person isn't real. The AI coach recommended I do an easy run of 1 minute, nice! Just a little deceptive. The interface is quite bulky and hard to navigate as there's no central point to navigate, for example to get settings I need to navigate into my profile. I give an extra star because they were quick to respond for trouble shooting but kind of ironic that an app built on AI doesn't have an AI bot for simple trouble shooting questions.

reviews.title: Perfect for Community building
reviews.text: I really like this app because not only does it give you feedback on all your runs and goals, but it also sets the scene for a community with like-minded goals.

reviews.title: Love it!!
reviews.text: I've had such a great experience with Endorphins Run Club! The community is incredibly welcoming and supportive, no matter your pace or experience level. It's a great way to stay motivated, meet new people, and enjoy running in a fun, encouraging environment. The organizers do a fantastic job creating a positive atmosphere, and every run feels inclusive and well organized. I always look forward to run club each week and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a friendly running community.

reviews.title: Best Running Coach App!
reviews.text: I have been using this app for about a year now and I’ve used it to build training plans for running (including strength training) for 2 marathons and a half marathon! I absolutely recommend it for anyone just starting to run as well as experienced runners.

reviews.title: Makes Running a Passion
reviews.text: I’ve been using Endorphins to train for the Austin Marathon and it has made me passionate about running. I’ve tried different apps and plans, but most felt like it was ramping up mileage quickly and unattainable. I’ll be running the Chicago Marathon later this year and will be using Endorphins for inbetween races and the marathon! :)

reviews.title: Enjoying the app!
reviews.text: Really been enjoying using the app as a platform to supplement my runs!

reviews.title: GAME CHANGER
reviews.text: Endorphins has truly taken up my training up a notch. I used to guess what my next workout was, but now I have a customized plan for me! I have trained for a half with endorphins, and now training for a full marathon! Highly recommend to take your running to the next level, or a great guide to help you get started.

reviews.title: Great plans
reviews.text: I love the endorphins app for training plans! The plans feel very customized and I especially like that it takes weather into account and lets you add B races along the way

reviews.title: Amazing training app
reviews.text: I love this app for my training! As a physical therapist I feel like other training apps were a little too aggressive while Endorphins is more realistic and user friendly. I will continue to use this app for my future runs!

reviews.title: best running app ever !!!
reviews.text: I love this app so much!! It makes running so approachable and helps you build up a great running base. I also love the community elements  and how easy it is to feel part of the nyc running community through this app.

reviews.title: Great app for runners of all levels
reviews.text: I've really enjoyed using Endorphins Running. The training plans are easy to follow, workouts sync seamlessly, and the app keeps me motivated. Whether you're training for your first 5K or a marathon, it's a great tool to help you stay consistent. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Negative split inner quiet pulse
reviews.text: Data and motivation and interesting activity titles (so much better than easy 3 miles)

reviews.title: Game changer
reviews.text:
What I love most:
Training & Coaching: It acts like a pocket running coach, taking the stress out of planning what to do each day.
Motivation: The community feed and the interactive training scores make staying consistent feel like a fun, rewarding challenge.
Performance: The app is clean, easy to navigate, and uploads run data incredibly fast.Running no longer feels like a chore. It’s highly personalized and keeps me incredibly accountable. Highly recommend it to any runner, whether you are a beginner or prepping for a full marathon!

reviews.title: Good, But Could Even Be Better
reviews.text: I love running and use this app to hold myself accountable and stay consistent; running for longer periods and greater distances over time. One feature I'd love to see: a "DressMyRun" component with an adjustable Temperature Difference setting. Weather varies a lot season to season, from hot to cold, and my body heats up significantly once I'm running. I'd like to set a Temperature Preference (i.e. "Cold") so that when I check the hourly forecast, the app can tell me the best time to run based on how I actually feel during a run-not just the outside temperature (I already have the Weather App for that!).

reviews.title: This app changed my life
reviews.text: Thank you to the training plan and community at Endorphins I have lost 20 pounds and I have been fortunate enough to complete the 2026 La marathon thank you for all you Don

reviews.title: Best running app out there
reviews.text: I am obsessed with endorphins! I love that you can have your whole plan to review from the start. It helped me plan for the coming week workouts. The best part is the adjustments you can make along the way. These include, adjusting paces based on logged runs, adjusting workouts following missed runs, and being able to  adjust to your environment (I.e. weather, hill grade%, etc). I don’t know how I ever trained for races without this.

reviews.title: My Running Bestie
reviews.text: I enjoy this app over any other fitness/running app because it is all of the best in one place. I can link all my wearables to the app to have everything centralized, adjust my marathon planning as I go and also the social aspect is a huge addition. It has allowed me to find like minded people in my area and make new connections that wouldn’t have been possible without the app. I have used this effectively to train for two full marathons and will continue to do so for my final one this year!!

reviews.title: Motivating + holds me accountable!
reviews.text:
I joined endorphins in the fall of 2025 and have been using ever since, and absolutely love it! I used it to train for my spring half marathon — the workouts, coaches updates, and feedback are SO helpful and held me accountable. I also really enjoy the sense of community it brings and all the different group channels within the app to be able to communicate, support, and cheer other runners on! 

Tyler + his team have built an amazing community and I am so happy to be a part of it! 

Highly recommend if you need a training plan or just a little accountability!!!

reviews.title: Simply Way to Track Progress ⚡️
reviews.text: Since I started using Endorphins Running, I’ve been able to track all my running data in one place and actually see my progress over time. Before, I didn’t have a structured training plan, but now I have a personalized program that fits my goals. It’s made my training more organized and has helped me become a better runner. I recommend it to anyone who wants to start running or keep improving their running.🏃🏻 ⚡️🙌🏼

reviews.title: Great training app
reviews.text:
I’m fairly seasoned runner and I decided to give Endorphins a try for my next marathon training block after I was tired of cobbling together a program and resources and community feedback on my own. I’m really pleased thus far because endorphins is an easy to use one stop shop for my training. 

The training plans are what really sold me. They’re tailored to your specific goals and automatically adjust as your fitness changes, but you can still manually customize things whenever you need to. 

The community is supportive and encouraging, which makes tough training weeks easier to manage. 

Small details make a big difference too, like the option for live weather forecasts adjusting your target paces. As someone training through hot, humid Southern summers, this kept me sane and saved me from chasing paces that weren’t realistic on a given day.

On top of all that, the app just looks and feels easy to use. 

Highly recommend for runners of all levels, whether just getting in to it or those looking to get more serious about their training.

reviews.title: Consistency and Routine
reviews.text:
I’ve been dying to try a running app, when I got lucky and have gotten to try Endorphins for 4 months.  Honestly I wasn’t sure what to expect, but I’ve always struggled with sticking things through.  
This app has truly changed my perspective, the adjustments and individuality in each program has been my favorite thing. When it’s hot out, which it has been brutally hot out in NC, it’s adjusted my paces.  It’s helped me to slow down, and given me the opportunity to stay with the training.  There are days I know time wise I just don’t have enough time or energy in my tank to do a certain workout, but I’m able to adjust my plan, and move runs around to fit to my life without losing mileage.  
This app has been life changing and truly I’m beyond thrilled I’ve gotten a chance to use it and try it out. I absolutely will be purchasing it, when my trial is up!🫶🏃‍♀️
Thank you for making running, and training accessible!

reviews.title: Awesome Running App
reviews.text: Great app that has really helped me build out a marathon training block, track my sessions and tailor my workouts based on the evidence of how they have been going! Also super helpful to stay connected to others and build your running community :) Fantastic app overall
